$doc: docs/DESIGN_Scenario_Regression.md §3 — The simplest shooting test. Judge (1) the friendly Bradley fires at the hostile, (2) the hostile takes damage. Both vehicles are named 'M2 Bradley IFV' and a name resolves to ONE unit, so the cues use a hit on '*M2 Bradley IFV' with damage > 0 (only the friendly fires, so a hit is on the hostile).
